t_advice_summary_textbox.text: To summarise, the person before me wasn't really sure if there was any trend. For sure L vs R doesn't make a difference - potentially red and orange are good? and maybe short hats? But they were very uncertain!

vb_textbox.text: Hi! So, I am 90% sure there is no trend here - it seems so random. By the end I was quite loyal to the small red mushroom man (he seemed to consistently bring in a decent amount of mushrooms). I feel MAYBE there was a trend toward small mushroom men being better for 1x and tall mushroom men being better for 5x? But again, very unsure. In addition, I think maybe warm colours are better (red, orange, yellow). I saw no trend with choosing either left or right. Sorry I can't be of more advice but I really do think its random. Good luck! Hope you crack the code for the next person!
